findings.title: Finite semantic partitions are counted but not bound to exact unique clause identities
findings.detail: The helper accepts any66 current rows and150 legacy rows if revision/financial_authority match and unresolved_binding_names is empty. Duplicate/substituted requirement IDs can satisfy these checks; the resulting tracked semantic-review and HANDOFF still claim66 current and150 inherited clause decisions. Reviewed generator/test hashes and an exit0 nine-test checkpoint do not themselves bind the bytes of semantic-scoped-results-bffc558.json to that validated output.
findings.minimal_repair: Before any tracked writes, reuse the existing exact-row admission contract: require exact canonical current and legacy ID/text sets, unique IDs and allowed semantic statuses. Alternatively pin the already validated semantic output byte hash in a separately retained actual admission result and verify that commitment before parsing. Do not rerun qualification or change financial/product code.
findings.actual_failure_claim: NONE;static acceptance-condition gap, not an assertion that current supplied records contain duplicates
